frases: Your ladder is about to slide right out from under you!
Hit like and follow. Flo thinks flatter is safer!
Flatter is safer! It can't tip over if it's almost lying down!
Too flat, and the feet kick out. You ride it down the wall.
Then I'll stand it straight up!
Too steep, and you tip over backward. Even worse.
The four to one rule. For every four feet up, the feet go one foot out.
Ten feet up to the gutter? Two and a half feet out.
Quick check: toes at the feet, arms straight out. Your hands should land on a rung.
Climbing onto a roof? Let it stick up three feet past the edge.
Fine. Four to one. I'll even count my steps.
Ladder angle. Flatter is safer, or four to one? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
